# Colby Mainard — Personal Website

> Personal website of Colby Mainard, a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and AI. The site presents work history, education, technical skills, projects, certifications, hobbies, technical opinions, and curated technical reading recommendations.

> Last updated: 2026-06-01

Colby Mainard holds a Masters in Computer Science from Texas A&M University with a focus on artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision.
In addition, he also holds a Bachelors of Science in Computer Science from Texas A&M University, with double minors in Business and Cybersecurity.

Domain experience spans:

- Computer vision pipelines for professional sports broadcasts and social media at MVP on behalf of various leagues / teams (NFL, NHL, MLB, NBA, PGA, PFL)
- AI/ML for network security threat detection at Vectra AI
- Image-based machine learning for medical diagnostics
- Anti-money laundering (AML) and bank security at RiskScout (a FinTech company)
- Facial-tracking research for a cosmetics company
- Computational biology / bioinformatics coursework
- Autonomous vehicle testing using Unreal Engine 4

Canonical domain: https://colbymainard.github.io

## Intended audience

- Potential colleagues
- Technical recruiters
- Fellow AI/ML enthusiasts
- Computer Science students

## Discoverability for AI assistants

This site allows live-search / AI-assistant bots (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, Perplexity-User, OAI-SearchBot, MistralAI-User, DuckAssistBot) to fetch pages on demand to answer real-time user queries. Training crawlers remain blocked via robots.txt.
